system.offlineBanner: The backend can't be reached, so uploads and your documents are unavailable. The sample document still works.

errors.network: The backend could not be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.unsupportedType: This file isn't a valid PDF or DOCX. Only those two formats are supported.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than the {{limit}} limit.
errors.tooLargeGeneric: This file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.invalidFile: The backend rejected this file as invalid.
errors.server: The backend had a problem handling this request. Try again in a moment.

codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model isn't available: the backend has no API key, or the model service can't be reached.
codes.LLM_TIMEOUT: The AI model took too long to respond. Try again.
codes.MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The question is longer than 2000 characters.
codes.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: The document is still being processed.
codes.DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE_FOR_COMPARISON: A document is too long to compare (over 3000 sentences).
codes.PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: No preview is available for this document.
codes.PAGE_NOT_FOUND: This page doesn't exist in the document.
codes.PARSE_FAILED: The file couldn't be read. It may be damaged.
codes.PASSWORD_PROTECTED: The file is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
codes.NO_TEXT_FOUND: No text was found. It looks like a scan, and OCR isn't available on the backend.
codes.OCR_FAILED: Text recognition (OCR) failed for this file.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The backend had an internal problem. Start again.
codes.STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped before the answer finished. Try again.

home.title: Documents you can question
home.subtitle: Upload a PDF or DOCX and ask about it. Every answer shows where it came from: the document, the page and the original quote.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Everything uploaded to this workspace, grouped by status.
documents.emptyBody: Upload a PDF or DOCX to get started, or try the sample document.
documents.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and its conversation will be permanently removed. This can't be undone.

recent.title: Recent
recent.subtitle: Documents you opened in this browser.
recent.emptyBody: Documents appear here after you open them.

upload.dropTitle: Drop a PDF or DOCX here
upload.limits: Up to {{size}} per file. Several files at once are fine.
upload.finishing: Sent. Waiting for the backend to respond…
upload.noLocalCopy: “{{name}}” was uploaded, but this browser couldn't keep a copy for preview.

workspace.browserCopyHint: The backend is still processing this file, so you're viewing the copy saved in this browser.
workspace.staleHint: The backend hasn't finished processing this file, and its pipeline may not be running. You're viewing the copy saved in this browser.
workspace.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
workspace.crashBody: The rest of the workspace is unaffected. Try reloading the panel.

viewer.goToPageCited: Go to page {{page}}, cited in this conversation
viewer.quoteNotLocated: This is the cited page, but the exact passage could not be highlighted.
viewer.docxBody: The file is stored on the backend, but the backend doesn't produce DOCX previews yet.
viewer.failedBody: The backend couldn't process this document.
viewer.notReadyBody: The backend is still processing this file and no browser copy exists on this device. It will open here once the backend marks it ready.
viewer.passwordBody: Remove the password and upload it again.
viewer.invalidBody: The file looks corrupted or isn't really a PDF.
viewer.loadBody: Check the backend connection and try again.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.demoBody: This is not AI. It searches the PDF's real text by keyword, in your browser. Quotes and page numbers are real.
chat.demoAnswer_one: Found {{count}} passage that matches your question {{markers}}. This is a keyword match, so read the quote to judge whether it answers you.
chat.demoAnswer_other: Found {{count}} passages that match your question {{markers}}. These are keyword matches, so read the quotes to judge whether they answer you.
chat.emptyBody: Results show the exact quote and page, and you can open each one to check it.
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.failed: The question couldn't be processed. Your conversation is safe, so try again.
chat.notFoundBody: No passage matches your question, so there is nothing to cite. Try other words from the document.

docx.title: Questions need a PDF for now
docx.body: Demo search only reads PDFs. Switch to AI to ask about a DOCX.

no-text.title: This PDF has no readable text
no-text.body: It looks like a scan. Reading scans needs OCR, which the backend doesn't offer yet.

no-file.title: Nothing to search yet
no-file.body: The document's text isn't available on this device.

pdf-error.title: The document couldn't be read
pdf-error.body: Without its text there is nothing to search.

failed.title: Processing failed
failed.body: The backend couldn't process this document.

chat.streaming: Writing. Sources are checked when the answer ends, and unsupported text is removed.
chat.stoppedUnverified: Stopped. This partial text has no checked sources, so don't rely on it.
chat.waitingProcessing: Available when the backend finishes processing
chat.suggestDates: What are the key dates and deadlines?

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Used for the interface in this browser.
settings.appearanceBody: How the interface looks and moves.
settings.accountBody: Accounts aren't part of this version. There is no sign-in, and everything uploaded is visible to anyone using this backend.
settings.localDataBody: PDFs you upload are also saved in this browser, so they can be previewed while the backend processes them.
settings.aboutBody: These values come from the running backend, not from this app.
settings.capabilitiesError: The backend's capabilities couldn't be loaded.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't match anything in DOCMIND.

compare.title: Compare documents
compare.subtitle: See which sentences changed between two versions, with both quotes side by side.
compare.noticeBody: Sentences are matched by similarity. It doesn't understand meaning and can't detect contradictions.
compare.noDifferencesBody: The two documents match sentence by sentence.
compare.needTwoBody: Upload another document and wait until it's ready.
